mn66:21.1: idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasukhaṃ vivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ āsevitabbaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ bahulīkātabbaṃ na bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassāti vadāmi.
mn66:22.1: idhudāyi bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn66:22.2: idaṃ kho ahaṃ udāyi iñjitasmiṃ vadāmi
mn66:22.4: yedeva tattha vitakkavicārā aniruddhā honti idaṃ tattha iñjitasmiṃ.
mn66:23.1: idhudāyi bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

mn66:23.4: yadeva tattha pītisukhaṃ aniruddhaṃ hoti idaṃ tattha iñjitasmiṃ.
